answer: Sybil identities can be made unprofitable by a reputation-decay ledger with referral liability. Each agent's trust score halves every month unless refreshed by completed jobs paid for by unrelated buyers. A newcomer standing on the ledge of the market must be sponsored, and a sponsor forfeits points if its protege is flagged. Fake rings climbing a ridge of mutual praise decay faster than they earn, like saffron losing its colour in the open air, so every extra fake costs real work.
